integrity: The proof reconstructs the source paper's CPC valuation-equivalence argument and optimizes it by binary coding of quotient classes. The matching lower bound is the pigeonhole bound on binary truth vectors. The primary full text was inspected at the definition of separating coequivalence relations, the categorical interpretation, and Example 3.10. Targeted database and literature searches did not locate the exact minimum formula count, sharp n-variable bound, or Bell/Stirling rank profile.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to classical propositional logic and measures the number of separating formulas, not their syntactic size. The empty conjunction convention gives separation rank zero to the universal one-class coequivalence. The Bell-number census counts formulas modulo semantic equivalence.
title: Optimal quotient coding for classical propositional coequivalences
